sections.section_title: Cumulative Frequency Diagram or Ogive curve
sections.content_markdown: Cumulative frequency diagram or Ogive curve: Cumulative frequency diagram or Ogive curve is drawn by taking the upper limit of class interval along with $x$-axis and cumulative frequency along with $y$-axis after classification of a data.

Ogive curve of cumulative frequency of data is drawn taking each square of graph paper as two units of upper limit of class interval along with $x$-axis and cumulative frequency along with $y$-axis.
